questions.stem: Using collision theory, what is the main reason that increasing temperature has such a large effect on reaction rate?

options.text: A much greater proportion of collisions have energy equal to or greater than the activation energy
The activation energy is reduced at higher temperatures
Particles collide more frequently because they move faster
More particles are created at higher temperatures

questions.explanation: While particles do move faster at higher temperatures (causing more frequent collisions), the main reason for the large effect is that a much greater proportion of collisions are energetic enough to overcome the activation energy barrier. This means many more collisions result in successful reactions.
